article.headline: Chavez scores 18 as No. 14 Oklahoma women defeat Montana State 81-64
article.description: — Aaliyah Chavez scored 18 points and No. 14 Oklahoma cruised by Montana State 81-64 in the Jacksonville Classic on Tuesday.
article.linkText: Chavez scores 18 as No. 14 Oklahoma women defeat Montana State 81-64
article.story: JACKSONVILLE, Fla. -- — Aaliyah Chavez scored 18 points and No. 14 Oklahoma cruised by Montana State 81-64 in the Jacksonville Classic on Tuesday. The Bobcats led after one quarter but the Sooners steadily pulled away. Sahara Williams added 16 points, Jordan Speiser hit five 3-pointers for 15 points and LeeLee Bell scored 13 for Oklahoma (8-0), off to its best start in 16 years. Sa'Myah Smith grabbed 10 rebounds and Chavez had eight assists for the Sooners, who went 2-0 in the tournament. The Sooners were averaging 100 points and a winning margin of 45.7 points entering the game. Taylee Chirrick scored 16 points for Montana State (2-2), which lost 76-60 to No. 8 Iowa to start the road trip. Brianne Bailey added 12 points. The Bobcats finish the tournament on Wednesday. Montana State led 16-15 after one quarter, powered by an 11-0 run but Oklahoma made 8 of 16 shots, including four 3-pointers, to race to a 38-28 halftime lead. The Sooners used an early 12-0 run to go up 29-18 and bumped that to 35-22. The Bobcats let the Sooners reel off 10-straight points to push the lead to 17 in the third. Montana State had a string of nine-straight misses in the quarter, which ended with Oklahoma on top 58-41. Oklahoma shot 43.5% with nine 3-pointers while the Bobcats had three 3s and shot 38% while being outrebounded 50-20. The Sooners had 22 turnovers.
